items.html: And behold, how the judgments and Gevurot departed from ZA — they were going to his back side, to enter and spread in the female, and by this they were connected back to back. And now, upon their departure from within him and their entry into her without the agency of ZA, she was separated and sawed from him, and all those Gevurot were given in her. It follows that the giving of the judgments and Gevurot into her without the agency of ZA causes the sawing, that she be separated from him, for she receives nothing from him. And these two things — the giving of the Gevurot into her, and the sawing — were done as one.
